_comment: The tech tree (spec section 4). Everything here is data: nodes, costs, prerequisites, exclusive groups, effects and positions in the shop. See docs/DATA_FORMAT.md.

nodes.name: Basic Deflector
nodes.description: Standard shield. Capacity 100, recharge 12/s, delay 3 s.

nodes.name: Bastion I: Dense Emitters
nodes.description: A big, slow shield. Choosing Bastion locks the Flicker branch.

nodes.name: Bastion II: Layered Field
nodes.description: More capacity.

nodes.name: Bastion III: Hardened Matrix
nodes.description: All incoming damage is reduced by 15 % while the shield is above 50 %.

nodes.name: Bastion IV: Deep Capacitors
nodes.description: More capacity. The shield still recharges at 25 % speed when no power is routed to it.

nodes.name: Aegis Bulwark
nodes.description: Capstone. Once per stage a lethal hull hit is fully absorbed and the shield is restored to 50 %.

nodes.name: Flicker I: Rapid Cycling
nodes.description: A small, fast shield that hugs the turret. Choosing Flicker locks the Bastion branch.

nodes.name: Flicker II: Overclocked Coils
nodes.description: Faster recharge.

nodes.name: Flicker III: Instant Restart
nodes.description: The shield starts recharging 0.6 s after the last hit.

nodes.name: Flicker IV: Reflex Field
nodes.description: Recharge is doubled for 2 s after the shield breaks.

nodes.name: Phase Pulse
nodes.description: Capstone. When the shield goes from empty to full it emits a 300 m shockwave that damages and staggers enemies and destroys their projectiles.

nodes.name: Shield Harmonics
nodes.description: 20 % less damage from energy attacks.

nodes.name: Kinetic Dampers
nodes.description: 20 % less damage from kinetic attacks.

nodes.name: Pulse Laser Mk I
nodes.description: Rapid hitscan energy bolts. Good against shields, weak against armour.

nodes.name: Pulse Laser Mk II
nodes.description: More damage and less heat per shot.

nodes.name: Pulse Laser Mk III
nodes.description: More damage, a higher fire rate and less heat per shot.

nodes.name: Beam Laser
nodes.description: Continuous beam. Damage ramps up while it stays on a target.
